text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:
- Airplane manufacturer Pilatus-Werke will deliver 17 PC-9 planes to the Croatian army this year.
- Georg Fischer sold its Grundmann subsidiary to Kaba Holding.

- Jean-Francois Bergier, president of the expert commission looking into Switzerland's role in World War Two, called the shredding of documents at Union Bank of Switzerland "serious" and called for a total ban on the destruction of documents at banks, insurance and trust companies.
- More than 30,000 visitors attended this year's tourism and travel exhibition in Basle, which featured 341 exhibitors.
- Visits made to psychiatrists in Geneva have quadrupled since the 1980's.
